Author: TuaCreations
Name: K.I.S.S. RP Combat Logger
Punchline: Live roll log, enemy HP and party state for Star Garden RP events.
Description: Shares one live combat state across everyone in a Star Garden event. The GM's client reads /random rolls from chat and applies the Garden combat rules; every player sees enemy HP, party HP, Momentum and the roll log in a window, plus enemy markers drawn in the world.
